name: University of Mons
summary: French-speaking university in Mons; bachelor's are taught in French, and the engineering faculty's three English-taught degrees are master's.

handoff.label: Bachelor registration: EU students with a degree from abroad

ib.text: A full IB Diploma from an IB-recognised school needs no equivalence. Courses are mostly in French: without proof of French you sit UMONS's French proficiency test (written and oral, €50).

notes: Engineering needs a pass in the faculty's entrance exam; without a Belgian CESS or engineering equivalence you also sit French, history, geography, science and a second language.
EU students with a degree from abroad register online, and the page gives 30 September as the last day, without naming a year.
Medicine, law, speech therapy and engineering each have their own registration procedure.
